name: Sreenath Bhasi
bio: Sreenath Bhasi is an Indian film actor and musician who works in Malayalam films. He started his career as a radio RJ in Red FM 93.5. At the same time he worked as a VJ in Kiran TV. His film Da Thadiya made him more familiar to the audience, where he played a partner to the main role.

Using secrets and manipulation, he rises to power, but his ambition quickly turns to greed. Just as he dominates the industry, a dangerous international threat emerges.
